question: What causes day and night on our beautiful Earth? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! Day and night happen because the Earth is always spinning like a giant top! 🌍
hint: Think about a spinning toy.

question: Where does the bright sun rise every morning? 🌅
explanation: Great job! Every morning, the sun always peeks up from the East to start the day. 🌅
hint: It is the opposite of West.

question: What do we call the beautiful time when the sun goes down? 🌇
explanation: Super! When the sun disappears in the evening to let the moon shine, we call it a sunset. 🌆
hint: The sun is setting down.

question: Which big object gives us warm light during the day? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! The Sun gives us all the natural light and warmth we need during the daytime! ☀️
hint: It is big, yellow, and very hot.

question: What happens when our part of Earth faces away from the sun? 🌑
explanation: Awesome! When the sun's light cannot reach us, the sky turns dark and it becomes night! 🌌
hint: We can see the stars when this happens.

question: How long does Earth take to spin around completely one time? ⏳
explanation: Great job! It takes exactly 24 hours to finish one full day and night cycle. ⏰
hint: It is the number of hours in one full day.

question: What do animals like owls mostly do during the day? 🦉
explanation: Super! Owls are night animals, so they sleep all day and wake up at night to hunt. 🦉
hint: They rest in the sunlight.

question: What is the brightest star we can see in the day sky? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! The Sun is actually a giant star, and it is the closest one to our planet! ☀️
hint: It keeps us warm.

question: Where does the sun set when evening comes? 🌇
explanation: Awesome! After traveling across the sky, the sun always sets in the West. 🌇
hint: It is the opposite of East.

question: When are our shadows the shortest during the day? ☀️
explanation: Great job! At noon, the sun is right above our heads, making our shadows very short! 🕛
hint: This is lunchtime.

question: Which season is very hot and perfectly sunny? ☀️
explanation: Super! Summer is the warmest season when we love to eat ice cream and play in the water. 🏖️
hint: We get a long school holiday during this time.

question: What do we wear to stay warm in the cold winter months? ❄️
explanation: Fantastic! Woolen sweaters and jackets trap our body heat and keep us cozy in winter. 🧥
hint: They are thick and warm.

question: Which season brings heavy and beautiful rainfall? 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! The monsoon season brings lots of rain, filling up rivers and helping plants grow. ☔
hint: We love jumping in puddles!

question: What grows beautifully everywhere during the spring season? 🌸
explanation: Great job! Spring is known as the king of seasons because colorful flowers bloom everywhere! 🌺
hint: They smell sweet and attract bees.

question: In which season do many trees drop their dry leaves? 🍂
explanation: Super! During autumn, leaves turn yellow and brown before falling off the trees to get ready for winter. 🍁
hint: It is also called the Fall season.

question: What causes the changing seasons on our Earth? 🌍
explanation: Fantastic! Seasons change because the Earth moves around the Sun in a special tilted path. 🔄
hint: Our planet's big journey around the sun.

question: What cold treat do we love to eat in summer? 🍦
explanation: Awesome! Cold treats like ice cream help us cool down when the summer sun is very hot! 🍨
hint: It comes in flavors like chocolate and vanilla.

question: What tool helps us stay completely dry in the monsoon? ☔
explanation: Great job! An umbrella is like a little portable roof that keeps the raindrops away from us. ☂️
hint: We open it up when it rains.

question: How long does Earth take to go around the Sun completely? ☀️
explanation: Super! It takes Earth one whole year (or 365 days) to finish its big trip around the Sun! 📅
hint: It is the time from one birthday to the next.

question: Which pleasant season comes right after winter? ⛄
explanation: Fantastic! After the cold winter, the warm and flowery spring season arrives to cheer us up. 🌸
hint: Flowers start to bloom in this season.

question: What beautiful object shines brightly in the night sky? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! The Moon lights up our night sky and changes its beautiful shape over the month! 🌕
hint: It comes out when the sun goes to sleep.

question: What do we call a perfectly round, bright moon? 🌕
explanation: Great job! When we can see the whole glowing circle of the moon, it is called a Full Moon. 🌝
hint: It looks like a big bright plate.

question: When we cannot see the moon at all, what is it called? 🌑
explanation: Super! When the moon hides in the dark sky and we cannot see it, we call it a New Moon. 🌑
hint: The sky is very dark on this night.

question: What funny shape does a crescent moon look like? 🌙
explanation: Fantastic! A crescent moon is a thin, curved slice of light that looks just like a bright banana! 🍌
hint: It is a curved, yellow fruit.

question: How long does the moon take to change through all its shapes? 🌔
explanation: Awesome! The moon takes about one full month to go from New Moon back to New Moon again. 📅
hint: It takes about 30 days.

question: Does the moon make its own glowing light? 💡
explanation: Great job! The moon acts like a giant mirror, bouncing the Sun's light down to us on Earth! ☀️
hint: It borrows light from a big star.

question: Which moon shape comes just after the New Moon phase? 🌑
explanation: Super! As the moon starts to peek out from the dark, it first looks like a tiny sliver or Crescent. 🌙
hint: The banana shape.

question: What do we call a moon that is exactly half visible? 🌗
explanation: Fantastic! When we see exactly half of the moon lit up, it is simply called a Half Moon! 🌓
hint: It is cut right down the middle.

question: What is the traditional Indian name for a Full Moon night? 🌕
explanation: Awesome! In India, the bright and beautiful Full Moon night is celebrated as Purnima. 🌝
hint: It starts with a P.

question: What is the traditional Indian name for a New Moon night? 🌑
explanation: Great job! The dark, moonless night of the New Moon is known as Amavasya in India. 🌑
hint: Diwali is celebrated on this dark night.

question: What do some smart birds do when winter gets too cold? ❄️
explanation: Super! Many birds fly away to warmer places to escape the freezing winter snow! 🦅
hint: They use their wings to travel.

question: What is the journey of animals to find warmer places called? 🌍
explanation: Fantastic! When animals travel a long way to find a better season, it is called migration. 🗺️
hint: It starts with an M.

question: What do bears do to survive the very cold winter months? 🐻
explanation: Awesome! Bears find a cozy cave and sleep deeply all winter to save their energy! 💤
hint: We do this in our beds at night.

question: What is the deep winter sleep of some animals called? 😴
explanation: Great job! A long, deep winter sleep that helps animals stay safe from the cold is called hibernation. 🐻
hint: It rhymes with 'station'.

question: Why do animals migrate to completely new places? 🗺️
explanation: Super! When winter covers their home in snow, animals migrate to find yummy food and a warm home. 🌾
hint: They need this to fill their tummies.

question: Which beautiful insect travels very far before winter arrives? 🦋
explanation: Fantastic! The amazing orange and black Monarch Butterfly flies thousands of miles to find warmth! 🦋
hint: It has colorful wings.

question: What do frogs do to stay safe when it gets very cold? 🐸
explanation: Awesome! Frogs dig down into the mud at the bottom of ponds and sleep until spring comes! 🕳️
hint: They hide under the wet dirt.

question: Which amazing bird is famous for traveling across the whole world? 🦅
explanation: Great job! The Arctic Tern flies from the top of the world to the bottom and back every year! 🕊️
hint: It is a white bird from the Arctic.

question: What do many trees do just before winter arrives? 🌳
explanation: Super! Trees drop their leaves to save water and energy during the freezing winter time. 🍂
hint: They drop something on the ground.

question: How do migrating birds know exactly where to go? 🦅
explanation: Fantastic! Birds use the sun, stars, and Earth's invisible magnets like a giant natural map! 🌍
hint: They follow signals from nature.

question: What is the first step a hardworking farmer takes to grow crops? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! The farming cycle always starts with planting tiny seeds into the soft soil. 🌾
hint: Putting tiny plants into the dirt.

question: Which season is best for planting seeds that need lots of water? 🌧️
explanation: Great job! Farmers love the monsoon because the rain gives their new crops plenty of water to drink! ☔
hint: The rainy season.

question: What do we call the happy time when crops are ready to be cut? 🌾
explanation: Super! When the golden crops are fully grown and ready, farmers cut them in a process called harvest! 🚜
hint: Gathering the grown food.

question: Which wonderful festival celebrates the harvest season in Punjab? 🥁
explanation: Fantastic! People in Punjab celebrate Baisakhi with music and dancing to welcome the new crops! 🌾
hint: Starts with a B.

question: Which popular harvest festival is celebrated in Tamil Nadu? 🍚
explanation: Awesome! In Tamil Nadu, people cook a special sweet dish and thank the Sun god during Pongal! ☀️
hint: They cook a sweet rice dish with this same name.

question: What sharp tool helps farmers gently cut the ready crops? ✂️
explanation: Great job! A sickle has a sharp, curved blade shaped like a crescent moon, perfect for cutting tall grass and crops. 🌙
hint: It looks like a curved moon.

question: Which famous and joyful harvest festival belongs to Assam? 💃
explanation: Super! People in Assam celebrate Bihu with beautiful traditional dances and delicious food! 🌱
hint: A short, four-letter word.

question: What do young crops need along with water to grow well? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! Just like us, plants need food, and they make it using the bright energy of sunlight! 🌞
hint: It comes from the big yellow star in the sky.

question: Which beautiful festival celebrates the grand harvest in Kerala? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! During Onam, people in Kerala make flower carpets and enjoy thrilling boat races! 🛶
hint: Starts with the letter O.

question: Why do farmers happily celebrate all these harvest festivals? 🎉
explanation: Great job! Harvest festivals are a wonderful way for farmers to give thanks to nature for providing food! 🙏
hint: Saying 'thank you' to nature.
